3300: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body straight.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders past your hands.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and your body straight as you lean forward.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3301: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back straight.
As you lower your body, lift your feet off the ground and bring your knees towards your chest.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then extend your legs back out and push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3302: Find an open space with enough room to perform a handstand.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Kick your legs up towards the wall, using your core and shoulders to maintain balance.
Once in a handstand position, engage your triceps to support your body weight.
Hold the handstand for as long as you can maintain balance.
To come down, slowly lower your legs back to the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3303: Start by gripping a vertical pole with both hands, palms facing each other, and arms fully extended.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Using your core and upper body strength, raise your legs until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3304: Start by hanging from a bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Engage your core and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Continue to lift your legs up and over your head, allowing your body to pass through the arms.
Once your legs are fully extended over your head, begin to lower them back down towards the starting position.
As you lower your legs, allow your body to pass back through the arms until you are hanging with your arms fully extended again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3305: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your heels to stand up, simultaneously pressing the barbell overhead.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height as you lower back into the squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3306: Set up the implement in front of you.
Grip it firmly with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift it using your legs and hips.
Hold it steady for a moment.
3307: Stand with feet wide and the keg between your legs, gripping it low with both hands.
Hinge at the hips, keep your chest up and your back flat.
Drive your hips forward hard and pull the keg up your body.
Extend fully and throw the keg up and back over the bar.
Reset, step back to the start and repeat with control.
3308: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over your mid foot.
Hinge down, grip the bar just outside your legs and brace your core.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close as you stand up.
Lock out with hips and knees extended and shoulders back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back to the floor.
3309: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high and hands steadying it.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and brace your core.
Sit down between your hips, keeping your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your whole foot and keep your elbows up the whole way.
3310: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar under control to your mid chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet planted throughout.
3311: Set the bar on the blocks or rack at front shoulder height.
Step in, rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Lift it off and stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest until your thighs pass parallel.
Stand back up by driving through your feet, then re-rack the bar.
3312: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your elbows and pull your chest towards the bar, keeping your body straight.
Once your chest reaches the bar, push down with your hands and drive your elbows back, lifting your body above the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3313: Position yourself between parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3314: Start by hanging from a pair of rings with your arms fully extended and your body in a straight line.
Spread your legs wide apart, forming a straddle position.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3315: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight out to the sides.
Slowly lean forward, keeping your arms straight, until your upper body is parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and hold this position for a few seconds.
Return to the starting position by pushing through your feet and standing back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3316: Load a light to moderate barbell and stand over it with feet hip width apart.
Perform the first lift of your chosen sequence, such as a deadlift.
Move straight into the next lift without setting the bar down.
Keep each rep crisp with a braced core and a flat back.
Finish all lifts for one round, then lower the bar and rest before repeating.
3317: Squat low at the edge of the vehicle with a flat back and hands underneath.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Drive hard through your legs and lift the edge to hip height.
Shift your hands and push up and over with your legs and arms.
Let it roll over fully, then step back and reset for the next flip.
3318: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and swing your arms in a circular motion, rotating your torso as you do so.
Continue the circular motion, swinging your arms and rotating your torso for the desired number of repetitions.
Remember to breathe throughout the exercise.
3319: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Start with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without locking out hard.
Lower slowly until your triceps touch the floor and repeat.
3320: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row both dumbbells toward your hips, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension and repeat.
3321: Hold the band in both hands in front of you with arms straight.
Stand tall with a soft knee bend and your core tight.
Pull your hands apart and out to the sides at shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap back.
3322: Stand with feet hip width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grab the handle with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
Hinge back down to set the kettlebell on the floor and repeat.
3323: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the bell and your arm vertical.
Roll onto the opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Come up to a tall seated position with your arm still locked overhead.
Reverse the steps slowly to lie back down, then switch sides.
3324: Anchor a band low behind you and hold the handles at chest height.
Stand in a split stance with your core braced.
Press one hand up and forward while rotating your torso slightly.
Return under control and press with the other arm.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides for the full set.
3325: Anchor a band in front of you at low height and hold both handles.
Stand in a staggered stance with arms extended.
Pull one handle back toward your hip while rotating your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
3326: Anchor a band high in front of you and hold both handles with arms overhead.
Stand tall in a staggered stance.
Pull one handle down toward your ribs while rotating your torso.
Keep your elbow tucked and shoulder down.
Return slowly and switch to the other arm.
3327: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lower your body down towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, lean your body forward and lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your hands.
Continue to lower your body until your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to lift your body back up to the starting position.
Maintain a straight line from your head to your heels throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3328: Stand holding a light barbell with an overhand grip at thigh height.
Lower the bar down your legs with soft knees and a flat back.
Stand up, then pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders.
Take a controlled step forward with the bar racked.
Step back, lower the bar and begin the next round.
3329: Sit on the roman chair with your feet locked under the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back slightly.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Pause at the top and keep your neck relaxed.
Lower back slowly under control and repeat.
3330: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and knees at the same time.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
3331: Lie on your back with legs raised straight and hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite hip.
Keep your legs steady and low back pressed down.
3332: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Let your torso drape back over the ball for a full stretch.
Curl up until your upper back clears the ball.
Lower slowly back into the stretch and repeat.
3333: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell held over your chest.
Place your free arm on your stomach or out to the side.
Lower the dumbbell with elbow flared out until you feel a chest stretch.
Press it back up over your chest.
Keep your torso square, then switch arms after the set.
3334: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in one hand over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Open your arm out to the side until your upper arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbell back above you.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
3335: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.
3336: Lie flat with legs straight and a dumbbell held in both hands overhead.
Lift your arms and legs together, forming a V shape.
Touch the dumbbell near your shins.
Lower back down slowly without dropping your legs.
3337: Lie on one side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Hold a dumbbell on your top hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds without sagging.
Lower, then repeat on the other side.
3338: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand or both hands.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the dumbbell toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand back up, then switch legs.
3339: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and switch the dumbbell hand halfway.
3340: Stand with feet hip width apart holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees slightly bent and back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
3341: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and torso upright.
Push back to the start and switch legs.
3342: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand, arms crossed in front.
Stand tall with a slight lean forward.
Raise both arms up and out into a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and shoulders down.
3343: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Sit tall and place your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly without letting the weights rest.
3344: Set the seat height and grip the handles with a slight elbow bend.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the center.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
3345: Sit with a forearm resting on your thigh or a bench, palm up.
Hold the hand spring in that hand.
Squeeze the handles together by curling your wrist and fingers.
Release slowly, finish your reps, then switch hands.
3347: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl both weights up to shoulder height without swinging.
Rotate your wrists slightly and press the weights overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then back down to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
3348: Place your hands on a bench or box and extend into a plank position.
Spread your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Keep your hips level and body in a straight line.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
3349: Set the cable low and hold the handle at your chest.
Step back to create tension and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down and back into a squat with your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
3350: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand sideways to the stack.
Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip.
Keep the other leg straight and feet flat.
Push off your bent leg to return to center.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.
3351: Hold a cable handle at chest height and step away from the stack.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.
3352: Kneel facing away from a low cable with a rope held between your legs.
Sit your hips back with a flat back.
Let the rope pull your hands back between your knees.
Drive your hips forward to a tall kneeling position.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and repeat.
3353: Face away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with one hand.
Stand in a split stance with your elbow pointing up.
Extend your arm forward and up until it is straight.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.
3354: Set the cable low and hold the handle against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels back to standing.
3355: Hold a cable handle at chest height, standing sideways to the stack.
Step wide to the side and bend that knee.
Push your hips back and keep your chest up.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
3356: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand facing away from the stack.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee stable over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.
3357: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with legs extended and the rope in your hands.
Sit tall with a straight back.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest, spreading your hands.
Extend your arms slowly and repeat.
3358: Kneel or sit on the floor under a high cable with a parallel grip handle.
Sit tall and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Return slowly to full arm extension.
3359: Set the cables at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
3360: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Lift your knees slightly off the ground, keeping your back flat and your core engaged.
Move your right hand and left foot forward simultaneously, followed by your left hand and right foot.
Continue crawling forward, alternating your hand and foot movements.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your core tight throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired distance or time.
3361: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and jump to the right, landing on your right foot.
As you land, swing your left leg behind your right leg and tap the ground with your left toes.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot.
As you land, swing your right leg behind your left leg and tap the ground with your right toes.
Continue alternating sides, jumping and tapping the ground with each leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3362: Lie on a bench with the cable behind your head and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Start with arms bent over your chest.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
3363: Set the cable at chest height and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Stand in a split stance, core tight.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
3364: Sit on a bench facing away from a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your back against the pad.
3365: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips down and back into a deep squat.
Pause at the bottom without rounding your back.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
3366: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot behind you.
Reach your free arm forward for balance.
Lower slowly until the back knee lightly touches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3367: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent and the foot lifted behind you.
Swing your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Lightly tap the back knee near the floor.
Stand up through the front foot, then switch legs after your reps.
3368: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold one dumbbell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Guide it back down and hinge into the next rep.
3369: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Whip the ropes up and down with alternating arms.
Keep your chest tall and your knees stable.
Continue for a set time at a steady pace.
3370: Hold the rope ends and stand in a squat position.
Start waving the ropes with alternating arms.
Jump up explosively and land softly.
Go straight into the next squat.
Keep going for a set time and rest when needed.
3371: Hold the rope ends in an athletic stance with knees bent.
Swing both ropes to one side.
Swing them across to the other side in a flowing motion.
Rotate through your torso a little.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set time.
3372: Hold the rope ends and stand with feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Whip the ropes alternately with your arms.
Alternate sides and keep the waves going.
3373: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn inward.
Keep the circles even and large.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Continue for a set time then rest.
3374: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn outward.
Keep the movement smooth and even.
3375: Stand with knees bent, a rope end in each hand and arms in front.
Sweep your arms out wide and slightly up.
Bring them back together in front of you.
3376: Hold the rope ends with feet together.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms and making waves.
Keep a steady pace for the set time.
3377: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold the rope ends in front of you.
Twist your torso to one side and swing the ropes.
Keep your chest lifted and continue for the set time.
3378: Hold the rope ends and stand in a split stance.
Start making waves with your arms.
Jump and switch legs in mid air.
Keep switching for the set time.
3379: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a rope end in each hand.
Raise both arms overhead and slam the ropes down.
Repeat quickly to make big waves.
Keep your core braced for the set time.
3380: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand in a quarter squat.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Whip the ropes down and up so waves travel low along the floor.
Keep the waves even and your hips stable.
Work for 20-30 seconds at a hard pace.
Rest, then repeat for several rounds.
3381: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Extend your legs with heels on the floor and body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.
3382: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Bend your knees and plant your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
3383: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips piked high.
Walk your hands back until your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
3384: Hold a rope end in each hand and stand in an athletic stance.
Raise both ropes overhead while rising onto your toes.
Slam them down hard while dropping into a squat.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Reset and repeat at a steady, powerful pace.
3385: Sit on the machine and set your back firmly against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety and lower the weight until your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot to extend your legs.
Stop just short of locking your knees.
3386: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Hook your lower shins under the roller and align your knees with the pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid swinging or lifting your hips.
3387: Place two sturdy chairs facing each other and brace them against a wall.
Grip the seats, lift your body and straighten your arms.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows pointing back and your chest up.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.
3388: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.
3389: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a chair seat, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Do not pull on your neck.
3390: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step edge, holding a chair for balance.
Let your heels drop below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise as high onto your toes as you can.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly into the deep stretch.
3391: Stand with feet wide and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your arms out to the sides.
Rotate your torso and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return through the middle and twist to the other side.
Move with control and keep your hips square.
3392: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your feet close together.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down, keeping your knees over your toes.
Go as deep as comfortable with your chest up.
Stand tall without locking out hard.
3393: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or holding something behind your head.
Lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your legs without arching your back.
3394: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Raise one knee toward your chest without letting your hips drop.
Place that foot down and lift the other.
Keep squeezing your glutes the whole time.
3395: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your hips.
Move slowly to stay in control.
3396: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Extend the leg again and press it down to the floor.
3397: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge back and swing the weight between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing the dumbbell overhead.
Let it fall back and hinge again.
Keep your back flat and your arms loose.
Control the dumbbell at all times.
3398: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
3399: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Push through the front foot to return.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side.
